habits.boundary_condition: Do not treat price as overriding explicit requirements such as Wi-Fi, an acceptable layover length, nonstop service when requested, or required departure/return timing.
habits.condition: When comparing flights that meet the trip's required timing, connectivity, and onboard-feature needs.
habits.default_action: Rank acceptable options by price and choose the cheapest one.
habits.exception_condition: A more expensive option may be appropriate when the cheapest option violates a stated must-have or has an unacceptably long or inconvenient layover.
habits.name: Cheapest acceptable flight
habits.preference_value: Prefer the lowest-priced flight that still satisfies essential itinerary and amenity constraints.
habits.rationale: Across the dialogues, the user repeatedly seeks the cheapest option while continuing to impose minimum quality constraints, indicating a reusable preference for minimizing price within an acceptable set rather than choosing the absolute cheapest flight regardless of quality.

source_evidence.contribution: Shows price is the default comparison criterion while layover quality remains relevant to acceptability.
